annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee: Fostering opportunities and managing risks from new technologies for public services, the organisation of work and more equal and inclusive societies
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee: Fostering opportunities and managing risks from new technologies for public services, the organisation of work and more equal and inclusive societies
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C series
annotation.summary_en: EESC exploratory opinion, requested by the European Commission, on AI and digitalisation in EU public services. It recommends transparency, human-in-command, bias audits, cybersecurity, worker training, social dialogue and non-digital access options to keep AI use inclusive and rights-based. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Transparency in algorithm design and human-in-command principle for AI in public services
Independent bias audits and clear accountability for AI-assisted administrative decisions
Public services must invest in cybersecurity and apply GDPR throughout development
Involve trade unions and social partners; provide training and upskilling plans
Keep non-digital access channels to prevent social exclusion
